limitations: Rule 7 (numeral height) is not measured: a photo has no real-world scale. This is a finalized team decision (rulebook Part B). It skips the measurement only; no product category is excluded.

Rule 8 (clear space around the net quantity) is estimated from the photo's own geometry (ratios to the numeral height, so no real-world scale is needed). It is only passed when the margin is generous; otherwise it goes to human review. Text input cannot be assessed.
Language (Rule 9) is checked on the whole label, not per declaration.
Legibility uses OCR confidence as a proxy; contrast is measured as luminance contrast around each declaration. Neither is a substitute for inspecting the physical label.

Results depend on what is in the photo. A declaration printed on another face of the pack will be reported as not found; low-confidence and partially read fields go to human review instead of pass/fail.
Standard pack sizes (Rule 5) are configured only for the six commodities in rulebook Part C. Other categories show NOT_CONFIGURED, which is not a legal exemption.
The MRP rounding rule (paise) is not checkable from a photo and is not implemented.
